title: Last Holiday
about: A shy shop assistant told she has weeks to live blows her savings on a luxury holiday in a grand European hotel.
cue: Serve the main when Georgia orders everything Chef Didier makes.
faces: Rich dark chocolate mousse with whipped cream.
